title: Sortierung und Pagination
description: As a developer, I want to sort and page through the registry, so that large lists stay usable.

acceptance_criteria.given: the own organisation owns prompts with different update timestamps
acceptance_criteria.when: the developer sorts by updated_at descending
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and the prompts are ordered from newest to oldest
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-015-sorting-pagination.feature: Results can be sorted by update time

acceptance_criteria.given: the filtered result set contains three pages
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and an empty page with the correct total count
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-015-sorting-pagination.feature: A page beyond the result range is empty

acceptance_criteria.when: the developer requests a page size of 5000
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 400 and states the maximum page size
and: the response contains at most the maximum number of items
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-015-sorting-pagination.feature: An oversized page size is clamped or rejected
